ex_zh: 我最近開始研究股票市場。
ex_py: Wǒ zuìjìn kāishǐ yánjiū gǔpiào shìchǎng.
ex_en: I recently started studying the stock market.

ex_zh: 投資一定有風險。
ex_py: Tóuzī yídìng yǒu fēngxiǎn.
ex_en: Investing always involves risk.

ex_zh: 早起是一個好習慣。
ex_py: Zǎoqǐ shì yí ge hǎo xíguàn.
ex_en: Waking up early is a good habit.

ex_zh: 通貨膨脹讓東西越來越貴。
ex_py: Tōnghuò péngzhàng ràng dōngxi yuè lái yuè guì.
ex_en: Inflation makes things more and more expensive.

ex_zh: 這個產業的趨勢很明顯。
ex_py: Zhège chǎnyè de qūshì hěn míngxiǎn.
ex_en: The trend in this industry is very clear.

ex_zh: 我現在多吃蔬菜，少吃肉。
ex_py: Wǒ xiànzài duō chī shūcài, shǎo chī ròu.
ex_en: I now eat more vegetables and less meat.

ex_zh: 資訊安全越來越重要。
ex_py: Zīxùn ānquán yuè lái yuè zhòngyào.
ex_en: Information security is more and more important.

ex_zh: 請不要把密碼告訴別人。
ex_py: Qǐng búyào bǎ mìmǎ gàosù biérén.
ex_en: Please don't tell anyone your password.

ex_zh: 我們的計畫是下個月去台灣旅行。
ex_py: Wǒmen de jìhuà shì xià ge yuè qù Táiwān lǚxíng.
ex_en: Our plan is to travel to Taiwan next month.

ex_zh: 今年的經濟成長比去年慢。
ex_py: Jīnnián de jīngjì chéngzhǎng bǐ qùnián màn.
ex_en: This year's economic growth is slower than last year's.

ex_zh: 法國的總統選舉每五年舉行一次。
ex_py: Fǎguó de zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ měi wǔ nián jǔxíng yí cì.
ex_en: The French presidential election is held every five years.

ex_zh: 睡眠不足會影響工作。
ex_py: Shuìmián bùzú huì yǐngxiǎng gōngzuò.
ex_en: Lack of sleep affects work.

ex_zh: 量子電腦可能改變密碼學。
ex_py: Liàngzǐ diànnǎo kěnéng gǎibiàn mìmǎxué.
ex_en: Quantum computers may change cryptography.

ex_zh: 人工智慧正在改變很多行業。
ex_py: Réngōng zhìhuì zhèngzài gǎibiàn hěn duō hángyè.
ex_en: AI is changing many industries.

ex_zh: 我想多讀一些研究論文。
ex_py: Wǒ xiǎng duō dú yìxiē yánjiū lùnwén.
ex_en: I'd like to read more research papers.

ex_zh: 我每個月都有固定的預算。
ex_py: Wǒ měi ge yuè dōu yǒu gùdìng de yùsuàn.
ex_en: I have a fixed budget every month.

ex_zh: 這個帳戶的利息很低。
ex_py: Zhège zhànghù de lìxí hěn dī.
ex_en: The interest on this account is very low.

ex_zh: 當季的水果比較新鮮，也比較便宜。
ex_py: Dāngjì de shuǐguǒ bǐjiào xīnxiān, yě bǐjiào piányí.
ex_en: Seasonal fruit is fresher and also cheaper.

ex_zh: 兩國的外交關係越來越緊張。
ex_py: Liǎng guó de wàijiāo guānxì yuè lái yuè jǐnzhāng.
ex_en: Diplomatic relations between the two countries are getting more and more tense.

ex_zh: 政府宣布了新的政策。
ex_py: Zhèngfǔ xuānbù le xīn de zhèngcè.
ex_en: The government announced a new policy.

ex_zh: 我今年的目標是每天早上七點起床。
ex_py: Wǒ jīnnián de mùbiāo shì měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
ex_en: My goal this year is to wake up at seven every morning.
